meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当你问起以前的会话时,它会分三步查:先返回一批带编号、时间的标题列表;再对感兴趣的那条展开前后时间线;最后只读取你选中的几条完整内容,而不是全部读一遍。
howto.when: 当你说“我们之前是不是修过这个?”、“上次是怎么做 X 的?”等询问过去会话(不是当前对话)的话,或需要调用以前的工作时触发。

say.text: 查一下我们上次是怎么修复登录超时的?
say.note: 命中的旧记录会先以标题列表返回,再挑取完整内容。

say.text: 搜一下这个项目里所有修 bug 的记录。
say.note: 会按类型过滤,只显示 bug 修复类条目。

say.text: 上周关于支付模块我们讨论过什么?
say.note: 会按日期范围搜索并给出相关条目。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude searches past sessions in three steps: show a compact title list, optionally show a timeline around a record, then fetch full details only for chosen IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about previous sessions (not the current conversation), e.g. "Did we already fix this?", "How did we solve X last time?", "What happened last week?".

say_en.text: How did we fix the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Old records come back as titles; pick one for full details.

say_en.text: Search all bug-fix records in this project.
say_en.note: Filters by type, showing only bug-fix entries.

say_en.text: What did we discuss about the payment module last week?
say_en.note: Searches by date range and returns matching entries.
